# claude 2.1.302 fixtures

Raw stdout (NDJSON) recorded from the real `claude` CLI 2.1.302 during spike S0
on `--model haiku`, one-line prompts, in an empty scratch directory. Home paths
are rewritten to `/Users/USER` and the scratch directory to `/tmp/arc-s0`. No
account email, org id or token appears in the streams.

Common flags: `--model haiku --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages --setting-sources project`
(`--setting-sources project` keeps the user's hooks and plugins out of the stream; stdin is `/dev/null` unless noted).

| File                      | Prompt and extra flags                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `text-turn.jsonl`         | `-p "Reply with exactly: pong"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `tool-turn.jsonl`         | `-p "Call the mcp__arc__ping_ro tool once and tell me what it returned."` `--mcp-config=<f> --strict-mcp-config --permission-mode plan --allowedTools "Read Grep Glob mcp__arc__*" --disallowedTools "Edit Write NotebookEdit Bash"`. `ping_ro` is declared with `annotations.readOnlyHint: true`.                                                                                                     |
| `plan-blocked.jsonl`      | Same flags as `tool-turn`, but the tool `ping` has no `readOnlyHint`: plan mode answers `Cannot call mcp__arc__ping while in plan mode.`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `permission-prompt.jsonl` | `-p "Run the shell command: echo hi > out.txt" --mcp-config=<f> --strict-mcp-config --permission-prompt-tool mcp__arc__request_permission`; the throwaway MCP server answers `{behavior:"allow",updatedInput:<input>}`.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `permission-deny.jsonl`   | Same, the server answers `{behavior:"deny",message:"Denied by Arc spike"}`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `interrupt.jsonl`         | `-p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages --replay-user-messages --model haiku --setting-sources project`, driven from a node script. `interrupt.stdin.jsonl` is what was written to stdin: a user message ("count 1 to 200"), a `control_request` interrupt sent after the 5th text delta, then a second user message after the first `result`. |
| `mcp-timeout.jsonl`       | `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT=10000`, tool `slow` waits 70 s: `MCP server "arc" tool "slow" timed out after 10s`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `auth-failure.jsonl`      | `HOME=<empty dir> claude -p "Reply with exactly: pong" --model haiku --output-format stream-json --verbose`. Exit code 1. `auth-failure.stderr.txt` is empty: the failure is only in the stream.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

The MCP config used was `{"mcpServers":{"arc":{"type":"http","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp"}}}`.

`subagent-background.jsonl` is the spec 005 spike stream of a model that starts a background helper agent (`Agent` tool): `stream_event`, `rate_limit_event` and `status` lines were removed. It shows the first `result` arriving while the helper still runs, then the helper's `parent_tool_use_id` events, `task_updated`, `task_notification` and `background_tasks_changed`.
